description: The top loop that drives and MONITORS creusot-sl across a whole crate. It schedules the crate's *.rs files leaf-first (propagating each proven callee #[ensures] as the caller's #[requires]), instantiates a creusot-sl sub-loop per file, and squeezes the base loop's soft outputs (its learned skills and inferred/strengthened contracts) against the mission guidance from a disjoint evidence base. Dominant coherent-and-wrong: a crate that LOOKS verified because each file went green, but where the base loop strengthened a contract for local convenience that is globally or guidance-wrong (e.g. specified network behaviour the guidance said to disregard). A Phase-0 architectural audit reads the implementation to seed U and rank the schedule; the functional claims it extracts are therefore ENDOGENOUS (declared below) — a PASS against them is self-consistency, not conformance. The top loop's own learned skills are closed at a cross-provider/human disjoint base.

actors.name: Cross-provider / human reviewer (terminus)
actors.builds: the terminal review of what the top loop cannot self-certify: its OWN learned skills, the editorial faithfulness of carve-outs, and self-description accuracy (sl-auditor Dimension 8)

upper_bound.text: the mission guidance: are the top loop's own skills / carve-outs a faithful reading of it, or do they share the loop's blind spot?

lower_bound.text: no executable oracle — soft-vs-soft faithfulness and self-description accuracy have no hard refuter; this absence is why the reviewer is the terminus
lower_bound.absent_reason: a same-provider-family judge shares the author's blind spot (only partial disjointness); closed by a disjoint cross-provider or human reviewer, not a machine

forbidden_moves: count a same-provider-family judge as full disjointness
certify without passing known-contradiction / known-consistent controls

disjointness.rationale: The scheduler holds 'what the dependency graph is' (never the specs); the base creusot-sl instances hold 'what discharges within a file'; the monitor holds 'what the guidance mandates across files' + 'what the base oracle actually returns' — a disjoint evidence base from the base loop that produced the skill/contract; the coordinator holds the guidance + aggregated verdicts (never producing a file's artifact). Intersection = a crate whose every file is base-DONE AND whose inferred contracts/skills survive the guidance + cross-unit oracle from outside the base loop. The base loop runs as a sub-agent so its rationale is physically absent from the monitor's context.
disjointness.load_bearing_barrier: the monitor and coordinator never see the base agent's rationale (it never leaves the sub-agent); they judge each base skill/contract only against the guidance U and the base oracle L

catchability.blind_spot: the base loop strengthens a contract for LOCAL convenience in a way that is globally or guidance-wrong (e.g. specifies network behaviour the guidance said to disregard)
catchability.via: the trigger/validity test against the guidance U and the cross-unit oracle L the base agents do not hold

catchability.blind_spot: mis-calibration — rubber-stamping (flags nothing) or saturating (flags everything); and an over-broad coordinator triage it does not police
catchability.via: flag-rate calibration + a periodic ground-truth comparison against a reference/gold annotation set (catches an over-broad TRIVIAL fast-path)

catchability.blind_spot: its claims are read OFF the code (endogenous), so a functional PASS against them is self-consistency mistaken for conformance
catchability.via: Gate A_top + endogeneity_flags: functional audit claims are recorded as self-consistency; only exogenous safety/robustness is claimed as conformance (docs/u-provenance-ledger.md)

catchability.blind_spot: a wrong topo-order (a callee verified before it is proven, or a file silently skipped)
catchability.via: the leaf-first order + cross-unit Gate B_top (each callee proven before its callers; no in-scope file skipped)

catchability.blind_spot: its own editorial judgment and the top loop's OWN learned skills
catchability.via: cross-provider / human review — the recursion stops at an external reviewer (sl-auditor Dimension 8)

disjointness.terminus: disjoint_base (a cross-provider or human reviewer closes the top loop's own-skill audit and the editorial soft side; the automation alone does not)
